purpose: Accumulate independent Taiwan PMI release vintages while preserving UNKNOWN for fields not explicitly available in the captured official release text.
positiveMechanism: New orders, unfinished orders, supplier delivery, inventories, input prices and outlook jointly separate demand acceleration from bottleneck accumulation.
Independent monthly release clocks make state transitions prospectively replayable without backdating to observation month-end.
The July-August-September sequence demonstrates that a high composite PMI can coexist with contracting or decelerating sector new orders.
falsification: Supplier-delivery time above 50 is not a monotonic bullish demand signal.
Backlog expansion may reflect delivery friction or old work rather than fresh demand.
Inventory accumulation may be deliberate buffering, forced accumulation or demand mismatch.
Industry subindices are survey diffusion measures, not issuer-level order quantities.
Sector-level fields are unadjusted and can contain working-day/seasonal effects; do not mix them with seasonally adjusted overall series as if directly comparable.
Missing fields remain UNKNOWN; no interpolation or forward fill is permitted.

pitSemantics.firstEligibleDecision: No earlier than authenticated publication/capture time for each release.
pitSemantics.revisionRule: Append a new vintage on revision; never overwrite the prior captured state.
pitSemantics.seasonalityRule: Industry-level PMI fields are unadjusted unless the source explicitly states otherwise.

reasonNoL4: Three release vintages improve replayability and falsification, but there is no prospective issuer-level outcome join, no complete common-support sector vector for every month and no OOS/incremental-value test.
exactNext: SC-041 map one industry state to listed issuers only with independently evidenced product/revenue exposure and preserve exposure magnitude UNKNOWN when not disclosed.
SC-042 define a dedicated shortage/supply-gap event contract rather than using high supplier-delivery time as a shortcut.
Prospectively append the next monthly release with native publication/capture clocks; do not backfill missing sector fields.
